instruction: Look at hard-08_seed.dxf. Create the hard AutoCAD drawing 'offset rectangular duct transition' using exact model-space coordinates in millimeters. Create or keep these layers exactly as needed: ANNOTATION, CENTER, CUTOUT, HOLE, OUTLINE, REFERENCE. Straight geometry may be LINE entities or straight LWPOLYLINE edges; every listed rounded or slot end must be an ARC entity using the listed start/end angles in degrees. Required straight segments: OUTLINE (0,20)->(100,20); OUTLINE (100,20)->(100,100); OUTLINE (100,100)->(0,100); OUTLINE (0,100)->(0,20); OUTLINE (150,0)->(290,0); OUTLINE (290,0)->(290,130); OUTLINE (290,130)->(150,130); OUTLINE (150,130)->(150,0); OUTLINE (100,20)->(150,0); OUTLINE (100,100)->(150,130); OUTLINE (100,20)->(100,100); OUTLINE (150,0)->(150,130); CENTER (50,20)->(220,0); CENTER (50,100)->(220,130). Required circles: HOLE center (20,40) radius 5; HOLE center (20,80) radius 5; HOLE center (80,40) radius 5; HOLE center (80,80) radius 5; HOLE center (175,25) radius 6; HOLE center (265,25) radius 6; HOLE center (175,105) radius 6; HOLE center (265,105) radius 6. Required arcs: CUTOUT center (100,20) radius 18 start 180 end 270; CUTOUT center (100,100) radius 18 start 90 end 180; CUTOUT center (150,0) radius 18 start 270 end 0; CUTOUT center (150,130) radius 18 start 0 end 90. Required text strings: ANNOTATION text ACAD-H08; ANNOTATION text OFFSET DUCT. Export exactly one DXF deliverable named C:\Users\user\Desktop\autocad_result.dxf to the output folder. You must complete all operations interactively through the graphical user interface (GUI) step by step. The use of external script files is strictly prohibited.
